Jinji Lake Leading Talent Program
Government Policy

Jinji Lake Leading Talent Program

Official government notice for the 20th batch of the Jinji Lake Science & Technology Leading Talent program. AI-powered OPC entrepreneurs are explicitly encouraged to apply. Benefits include 1–3M RMB startup funding, housing subsidies, and free R&D space.

Source: SIP Science & Technology Innovation Commission, July 2026 Read Notice
Jiangsu Province AI OPC Policy
Provincial Policy

Jiangsu Province's 18 AI OPC Support Measures

The first provincial-level policy in China to explicitly define and support AI-powered OPCs. Covers tax relief, subsidized computing power, talent housing guarantees, and a 100 billion RMB dedicated credit facility. Full English summary available.

Source: Jiangsu Provincial Development & Reform Commission, July 2026 Read Full Summary
